anchor_comparisons: Both cross-sector anchors sit near their component ceiling, but they are low-confidence ordinal comparisons and cannot transfer their numeric bands to this memory commercialization case.
The positive anchor resembles execution-led rerating, while the counter anchor warns that proxy valuation narratives can overstate rerating without durable economics.
disagreements: The analyst correctly emphasizes verified commercialization; the skeptic correctly limits extrapolation from peer gaps and past underperformance.
payload.rationale: Calibration credits the verified progression from yield and qualification to mass production, continued delivery, and revenue. It discounts both low-confidence cross-sector anchors and keeps the range moderate because valuation has partly moved already and product margins, allocation, and customer timing remain uncertain.
payload.why_not_higher: Further rerating requires durable product profitability and allocation evidence rather than commercialization milestones alone.
payload.why_not_lower: The current evidence is more developed than a qualification-only or broker-narrative case because shipment and revenue are present.
